notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - requests + bs4/lxml, browser impersonation UA, no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://zgallerie.com/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-ai rule and only disallows admin/cart/checkout/search/account paths; all /c-NNN-slug category pages fetched are allowed for User-agent: *. TREE: built from union of (1) homepage mega-menu top nav (FURNITURE, DECOR, ART & MIRRORS, PILLOWS & THROWS, BEDDING & CURTAINS, LIGHTING, RUGS, GIFTS, HOLIDAY), (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (560 collection URLs), and (3) each landing page's own <zg-subcategory> JSON taxonomy tree (decoded from data-subcategory attribute on c-2161-textiles, c-2372-pillows-throws, c-2404-bedding-curtains, c-33-rugs, c-2180-decor) plus breadcrumb confirmation on every recorded leaf (e.g. 'Home / Pillows & Throws / Pillows / Outdoor Pillows'). QTY: exact 'N items / Filter(N)' counter parsed from each leaf's own rendered category page (confirmed by h1 + canonical URL match on every leaf), never estimated or aggregated; internal cross-check confirmed Pillows(300)+Throws(28)=328=Pillows&Throws parent total, and Bedding(47)+WindowCurtains(19)=66=Bedding&Curtains parent total. EXCLUDED (documented judgment calls): all pure color/pattern/finish facet nodes under Pillows, Throws, Bedding, Window Curtains and Rugs (e.g. Solid/Patterned/Metallic/Leather & Hide/Shaped & Ball/Animal Print Pillows, Pillows-by-color and its 8 color sub-nodes, Solid/Patterned Throws, Printed/Solid/Velvet/Textured Bedding, Solid/Patterned Window Curtains, Solid/Patterned/Shag/Neutral/Black & White/Animal Print Rugs) - these are merchandising color/material cuts of the same product type, not distinct product-type subcategories, and were treated like a filtered View-All per rules.md Sec.15/27; all 'New X' nodes (New Pillows, New Throws, New Bedding, New Rugs, etc.) - marketing recency filter, no independent product-type meaning; all Sale/Clearance/Best-Selling variants (c-2192-textile-sale, c-2197-textiles-clearance, c-2402/2403 pillows-throws sale/clearance, c-2410/2411 bedding-curtains sale/clearance, c-2429/2430 best-selling) - promotional per rules.md Sec.27/35; Christmas Stockings & Tree Skirts (c-2338), Christmas Pillows & Throws (c-2339) and Festive Textiles (c-2184) - breadcrumb resolves to generic 'Home / Collections / Holiday Decor / Christmas / X' rather than the standard mega-menu ancestry seen on every other recorded leaf, indicating a seasonal promotional collection page, not standard nav (rules.md Sec.15); Robes (c-1837-robes, 1 item) - breadcrumb 'Home / Collections / Robes' shows the same generic-Collections pattern (not reachable from Bedding & Curtains or any primary nav dropdown; also absent from the c-2161-textiles taxonomy tree) - excluded as non-standard-nav, LOW-confidence candidate not included per instruction to prefer review queue over guessing (flagging here for optional human follow-up rather than fabricating a row); Faux Fur Textiles (c-2371) and Embellished Textiles (c-2481) - cross-category trend/marketing collections spanning multiple product types with no place in the mega-menu taxonomy tree, excluded as promotional collections per rules.md Sec.15/27; Pillow Inserts (c-1831) included as Textile but MEDIUM confidence since it is a stuffing/component product rather than a finished textile item. STORAGE: sitewide sitemap and nav scan for basket/bin/organizer/trunk/hamper/closet/wardrobe/caddy/cart keywords found only Jewelry Boxes & Storage (c-20-jewelry-boxes, h1 'Jewelry Boxes & Storage', breadcrumb Home/Decor/Jewelry Boxes & Storage) as a genuine Storage node; Storage Beds (c-1051-storage-beds) and Cabinets & Shelving (c-965-cabinets-shelving) are explicitly nested under the site's Furniture nav (Bedroom/Living Room Furniture) so excluded per Furniture boundary (storage.md Sec.21/27); no other storage/organization category exists on this site. No blocks encountered at any point.
